title: Single smart vertical window as a natural homology functor
statement: Let C be an abelian category and q a nonnegative integer. The smart window functor W[q,q+1) of [def-sp-double-complex-vertical-window] on nonnegative cochain complexes is naturally isomorphic to the composite of degree-q homology and the functor placing an object in degree q with every other term zero.

source.place: Proof steps 1 and 2, first sequence; spectral-object reformulation

proof.text: Extend a nonnegative complex by zero to the integers. Smart truncation from below at q replaces degree q by the opcycles; smart truncation from above at q takes the kernel of the induced outgoing differential, canonically H^q. Below q the first truncation vanishes, and above q the second vanishes. Restriction back to nonnegative degrees preserves these component identifications. All comparison maps are canonical kernel and cokernel maps, hence natural in morphisms of complexes. At q=0 extension supplies the zero incoming differential and the same formulas apply.
